description_en: Retrieves current data statistics metrics (real-time data), supporting queries grouped by instance ID, department, or skill group
description_zh: 获取当前数据统计指标（实时数据），支持实例ID、部门、技能组分组查询
name: GetIndexCurrentValue

parameters.help_en:
The list of department IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717975.html operation and check the DepartmentId parameter in the response to obtain the department ID.

When this parameter is not empty:
If GroupIds is not empty, the query is performed based on the skill group list corresponding to GroupIds.
If GroupIds is empty, the query is performed based on the department list corresponding to this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
部门ID列表。多个ID以半角逗号（,）分隔。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717975.html接口，查看返回参数的**DepartmentId**，即部门ID。

当该参数不为空时：
若GroupIds不为空，则优先以GroupIds参数对应技能组列表查询。
若GroupIds为空，则优先以该参数对应部门列表查询
parameters.name: dep_ids

parameters.help_en:
The list of skill group IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717970.html operation and check the SkillGroupId parameter in the response to obtain the skill group ID.

When this parameter is not empty, the query is performed based on the skill group list corresponding to this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
技能组ID列表。多个ID以半角逗号（,）分隔。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717970.html接口，查看返回参数的**SkillGroupId**，即技能组ID。

当该参数不为空时，优先以参数对应技能组列表查询
parameters.name: group_ids

parameters.help_en: The AICCS instance ID. You can obtain the instance ID from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview). The AICCS instance ID is required
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取。 AICCS实例ID必填
parameters.name: instance_id

Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回200表示请求成功
